messages.content:
你被給予一個名為"data_random_forest"的資料集，以資料框的形式呈現，你想要在這個資料上訓練一個隨機森林模型。你決定嘗試不同數量的樹和樹的最大深度，來觀察這些參數對模型表現的影響。

首先，你訓練一個有100棵樹和最大深度為10的模型。然後，你再訓練一個有200棵樹和最大深度為20的模型。接著，你訓練一個有300棵樹和最大深度為30的模型。最後，你訓練一個有400棵樹和最大深度為40的模型。

你可以使用'random_forest.train'函數四次，分別使用這些不同的參數，並比較這四個模型的表現嗎？

function.name: random_forest_train
function.description: Train a Random Forest Model on given data Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

n_estimators.description: The number of trees in the forest.

max_depth.description: The maximum depth of the tree.

data.description: The training data for the model.

2) n_estimators=200, max_depth=20, data="data_random_forest"
3) n_estimators=300, max_depth=30, data="data_random_forest"
4) n_estimators=400, max_depth=40, data="data_random_forest"

We'll assume passing the variable name works.

We'll produce calls accordingly and then ask them how to compare performance. We can also request evaluation metrics after each training. However, the instruction only asks to train and compare. So we'll do four calls and return results.
